blocks.text: The Philippines begins counting the votes cast yesterday in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). Commentators will tell us who won, which parties gained ground, which clans prevailed, and what the results mean for the new parliament. All of that matters.
